the following questions: 1) Is it possible for an algorithm to learn, tabula rana, superhuman proficiency at the game of Go? 2) Is it possible to train a neural network that can predict the winner of a game of Go?
the question of whether a machine can learn to play the game of Go from scratch.
the question of whether it is possible for an artificial intelligence system to learn a complex game such as Go without human knowledge, and if so, whether it can achieve superhuman performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the AlphaGo program is a reinforcement learning algorithm which learns from experience and is able to play the game of Go at a superhuman level.
AlphaGo Zero is an algorithm that can learn, from scratch, the game of Go, to superhuman performance, using only the rules of the game and self-play.
AlphaGo Zero is the first AI program to learn superhuman performance in a game without human guidance, supervision or human domain knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show a reinforcement learning based algorithm, AlphaGo Zero, can learn to play Go superhuman proficiency from scratch, and without human knowledge or guidance.
we have developed an algorithm to play the ancient game of Go without any human knowledge.
we have demonstrated that reinforcement learning is a viable approach to learning superhuman proficiency in the game of go, and that it can be done without human knowledge.

a machine learning algorithm can achieve human level mastery of a challenging domain without human knowledge, guidance or supervision.
